name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
summary: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Ragnar Thunderbrew keeps the family tavern supplied and its patrons fed. The dwarven brewer is known across Dun Morogh for the family's Beer Basted Boar Ribs.

sections.title: A Pillar of Kharanos Hospitality
sections.body: Ragnar Thunderbrew tends the kitchen and brewing work at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Mountaineers, travelers, and gnome refugees fleeing Gnomeregan gather there. His Beer Basted Boar Ribs, made with dwarven ale, are a Dun Morogh specialty. Supplies have grown hard to find since his usual meat provider enlisted in the King's Army. Ragnar now relies on wandering mountaineers and hunters to bring fresh crag boar flanks to the kitchen.

sections.title: The Thunderbrew Legacy
sections.body: Across Ironforge territory, the Thunderbrew name is known for dwarven drink and tavern life. Ragnar has kept the distillery running since his older brother, Grimbooze Thunderbrew, disappeared in a drunken haze a few harvests ago. He guards the family's brewing heritage against thieves such as the Dark Iron dwarves, who stole the recipe for Thunderbrew Lager. With patrons restless, supplies scarce, and disputes breaking out in the tavern, Ragnar keeps the taps flowing and travelers fed in Kharanos.

faq.answer: Ragnar Thunderbrew brews and tends the tavern at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. He also prepares the clan's famous ale-basted boar ribs.

faq.q: Why is Ragnar looking for boar ribs?
faq.answer: Ragnar's regular meat supplier enlisted in King Magni's army, leaving the kitchen short of ingredients. He buys fresh flanks from passing hunters and travelers to feed the tavern's patrons.

faq.q: How is Ragnar related to Grimbooze Thunderbrew?
faq.answer: Grimbooze is Ragnar's older brother. Their father, Arkilus, founded the Thunderbrew Distillery, and Ragnar has kept it running since Grimbooze disappeared in a drunken haze a few harvests ago.
Ragnar works inside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, in the central snowy hills of Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a cook, you can turn to Ragnar for the Thunderbrew family's Beer Basted Boar Ribs recipe and hearty dwarven tavern cooking.
As a dwarf passing through Dun Morogh, you can find a taste of home in Ragnar's tavern, with the clan's ale and rib cooking.
